amendments.new_text: Quotes are short excerpts kept so that each value can be checked against its paper; they remain under the publishers’ copyright, are not relicensed by ORCHID, and source papers are not redistributed.
amendments.old_text: Quotes are single sentences reproduced under fair use so that values can be checked; source papers are not redistributed.
amendments.reason: footer licence wording corrected (fair-use claim replaced by the release wording); items, quotes, layout and sample unchanged
